sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the Terminal guide, see The Ticket.

Terminal is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the twelfth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- When leaving this location by either dying or extracting, the state of the character is returned as it was before entering, besides the consumed access item.

- This location can only be entered through transiting from Shoreline in the time period of 21:00-6:00 after presenting an access item at the port garrison intercom.
| Icon | Item name |
| Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes; +; Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence | Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes; +; Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence |
| RFID keycard with unknown name | RFID keycard with unknown name |
| Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes | Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes |
| Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint | Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint |

sections.heading: Features
sections.text: Be aware of mortar fire barrages! The "The Eye" mortar strike signaling device can be equipped to get notified when one is very close.

sections.heading: Extraction
sections.text:
To locate the extraction use the maps below the table.
| Name | Faction | Always available | Single-Use | Requirements | Notes |
| Zubr Boat | PMC | yes | yes | The available boat seats depend on the number of players that entered the raid:; 3 seats with 1-3 players; 3 to 4 seats with 4 players; 4 to 5 seats with 5 players; Players who brought in the Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence must have it on them. | Upon arriving at the pier, the 3 minute extraction timer begins. |
